narrative_blocks: CERTIFICATE OF ACCURACY: I, Elena Rostova, certified translator in good standing with the Association of Translators and Interpreters of Ontario (Member #78921), hereby declare that I have translated the attached document from Spanish into English.

I further certify that to the best of my knowledge and ability, the English text is a true, complete, and accurate representation of the original document titled 'Certificado de Nacimiento' issued by the Civil Registry of Madrid, Spain.
SWORN STATEMENT: Subscribed and sworn before me in the City of Toronto, Province of Ontario, this 12th day of May, 2023. [Signed & Sealed by Commissioner of Oaths, Reg #ON-99482].

cases.title: Certified Translation of Marriage Certificate - Family Translation

fields.translator_declaration: I, John Smith, spouse of the applicant Jane Doe, certify that I am fluent in German and English and translated this marriage certificate accurately.

narrative_blocks: DECLARATION OF TRANSLATOR: My name is John Smith, and I am the husband of Jane Doe. I have translated her German marriage certificate 'Heiratsurkunde' into English.
I certify that I understand both German and English fluently and that this translation is a true rendering of the original document.

defect_spec.description: Translation was prepared by the applicant's spouse, violating regulations that strictly prohibit family members from acting as translators.
